title: Anthropic mathematician claims to have solved prestigious Millennium Prize problem with Claude

claims.claim: Anthropic matematikçisi Levent Alpöge, Claude'un yardımıyla Riemann hipotezini kanıtladığını iddia etti.

evidence.quote: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge claims he has proved the Riemann hypothesis, one of mathematics’s most notoriously difficult problems, with the help of Claude
An Anthropic employee and mathematician claims to have used the company's artificial intelligence (AI) chatbot to prove the famed Riemann hypothesis.

Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge claims he has proved the Riemann hypothesis, one of mathematics’s most notoriously difficult problems, with the help of Claude, cracking a puzzle that has eluded some of the world’s best mathematicians for decades.

claims.claim: Riemann hipotezi 1859 yılında ilk kez ortaya atıldı.

evidence.quote: First proposed in 1859, the Riemann hypothesis concerns the distribution of prime numbers and how zeroes of a function are involved.

claims.claim: Clay Mathematics Institute, çözülen her Millennium Prize problemi için 1 milyon dolar ödül sunmaktadır.

evidence.quote: Alpöge’s solution, presented in Lean, has only been published on his website and has not yet been publicly accepted by the Clay Mathematics Institute, which administers the Millennium Prize and offers a $1 million bounty for each problem solved.

claims.claim: Poincaré sanısı, kuruluşundan bu yana geçen çeyrek asırda resmi olarak çözülen tek problemdir.

evidence.quote: In the quarter-century since the prize was established, only one problem has been officially solved: The Poincaré conjecture, a topological problem concerning three-dimensional spheres.

claims.claim: OpenAI, Eylül ayında Navier-Stokes problemini çözdüğünü iddia etti.

evidence.quote: In September, OpenAI claimed to have cracked another, the Navier-Stokes problem, which concerns the flow of fluids.

OpenAI in September claimed that employees using a non-public version of its AI tools were able to solve part of a notoriously difficult problem in just 88 hours. The problem was part of the Navier-Stokes equations, which concern how fluids move.

claims.claim: OpenAI, Navier-Stokes girişimi için milyonlarca dolar harcadı ve 10.000 ajan görevlendirdi.

evidence.quote: OpenAI spent millions of dollars and deployed 10,000 agents in the attempt.
More than 10,000 AI agents, or computer programmed bots that operate somewhat autonomously, were put to the task as an AI training exercise.

claims.claim: Levent Alpöge, Temmuz ayında Claude kullanarak Jacobean varsayımını çözdüğünü söyledi.

evidence.quote: Though most of the spotlight has been on OpenAI’s movement in math, Alpöge said in July that he solved the Jacobean conjecture using Claude.
